description: ENS on Ethereum mainnet. A name (vitalik.eth) resolves to its address, and an address resolves to its primary name, accepted only when that name resolves back to the same address. Returns the avatar and the url, com.twitter, com.github, description and email text records when set. A name that is not registered returns 200 with address null. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
